products.title: HP Elitebook 840 G11 14 Business AI Laptop
products.description: The HP Elitebook 840 G11 is a 14-inch business AI laptop designed for high performance and portability. It features an Intel Core Ultra 7 165U 10-core processor, 16GB of DDR4 memory, and a massive 2TB PCIe SSD for fast storage. The laptop boasts a 14" FHD+ (1920x1200) non-touch screen, Intel integrated graphics, and runs on Windows 11 Home. Connectivity options include Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth, and multiple ports such as Thunderbolt 4 and HDMI. Additional security and convenience features include a fingerprint reader and a webcam.
